_why_star_pitch: Gravity Well, star pitch 13 (pitch_gravity_well.py, docs/gravity-well.md; its menu label Cosmic Pull, star_move_labels.PITCH_NAMES): the ball stops partway, orbits a star planet, then drops into the zone
_why_stats: Her stats row as charbuild builds it today: git-8a's balance pass (STOCK_ROWS), "???" from Extra Innings, and the captain flag + star swing 12 (Graffiti in menus; custom_swings makes it 13, Gravity Ball, in play) that star_swing_stats set for her
_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick), STOCK_ROWS: Luma, Mario, Luigi, Peach, the Toads good; Bowser, Bowser Jr., Larry, the Magikoopas bad
_why_table_rows: Today's per-character rows (Extra Innings' data for stock slot 0x48, after charbuild's stock edits) where they differ from Daisy's: TABLES name -> whole row, hex.
